routes.retired_because: A singleton chain has rank t but only t+1 hereditary objects; polynomial trace size does not imply a fixed rank bound.

C9000243.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 243 (Separating choiceless counting from polynomial time and witnessed choice.; papers: Choiceless polynomial time with counting does not capture polynomial time; Witnessed symmetric choice is strictly stronger than choiceless polynomial time with counting; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/243.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C243_CPT_MAIN.statement: P1 thm:main: the specified all-input eight-relation query is invariant, polynomial-time and not full counting CPT-definable.

C243_QUERY_PTIME.statement: P1 prop:query-ptime: invariance and polynomial-time consistency testing on every finite input.

C243_GRID_PAIR.statement: P1 lem:universe-size and prop:opposite-answers: equal-size zero/unit-charge grids with opposite query answers for L>=2.

C243_GRID_ACTION.statement: P1 lem:H-automorphisms: the specified central extension acts on each charged input and has the displayed signed commutator.

C243_SPARSE_COCHAIN.statement: P1 lem:sparse-cochain: t nonzero face curls admit a cohomologous cochain on at most 2Lt edges, including t=0.

C243_SUPPORT.statement: P1 prop:small-orbit-support/cor:transitive-support and P2 counterparts: polynomial orbit gives rank-independent K-support.

C243_BASE_EQUIV.statement: P1 prop:base-equivalence and P2 base:equivalence: the two analytical expansions agree in C^floor(L^(7/4)) for sufficiently large L.

C243_HOMOGENEITY.statement: P1 prop:base-homogeneity and P2 counterpart: equal wide types imply the same central-flow orbit under the quantitative tuple-width bound.

C243_HF_TRANSFER.statement: P1 thm:hf-transfer and P2 hf:transfer: nonempty base equivalence and quantitative orbit homogeneity transfer counting to all hereditarily supported finite ranks.

C243_CHARACTERIZATION.statement: GSW arXiv:2003.10935v1 Section 6 Theorem 18: full counting CPT properties are decided by polynomial-cost two-dimensional FO+H interpretation programs.

C243_TRACE.statement: P1 lem:trace-size: an interpreted run bounded by B has an invariant transitive vertex-code family of at most 9B^3 objects.

C243_STATE_EXACT.statement: P1 lem:state-exactness: the common stage formulas define actual tagged quotient states, halt and output exactly, including empty states.

C243_WIDTH.statement: P1 lem:substitution-width and its application: the fully expanded comparison formulas have a variable bound depending only on the fixed program.

C243_LOWER.statement: P1 07-separation.tex: every fixed full counting CPT program agrees on the zero/unit-charge pair for sufficiently large grids.

C243_UPSTREAM_SUPPORT.statement: Pinned U/Grid.lean proves subgroup_support_edges and small_orbit_support_edges for arbitrary group actions; these proofs have not been compiled locally.

C243_UPSTREAM_LOWER.statement: Pinned U/Separation.lean states invariant polynomial-time query and non-FullCPT.EvaluationDefinable; correctness is an unreplayed external premise here.

C243_INTERPRETATION_MATCH.statement: P1 06-coding.tex, GSWv1 Section 6, and U/Interpretations.lean agree on FO+H, generated quotients, existential relation saturation, first halt and state-size-sum cost.

C243_IL_SIMULATION.statement: Every total polynomial-cost binary interpretation program has a FullCPT simulation with polynomial time and cumulative occurring-object bounds, without fixed rank.

C243_MODEL_FIDELITY.statement: GSW18 plus the one-way simulation embeds the manuscript counting class in EvaluationDefinable, so accepting the pinned formal lower bound covers it without a rank restriction.

C243_RANK_WITNESS.statement: The singleton chain x_0=a, x_(t+1)={x_t} has rank t and t+1 hereditary objects; polynomial object count does not imply constant rank.

C243_FINITE_CHECKS.statement: Exact finite quotient, Hartig and one-face Heisenberg checks plus the universal trace-size polynomial identity pass; they do not prove a universal separation.

C243_WSC_MAIN.statement: P2 thm:main: one fixed one-WSC Boolean sentence on all finite inputs defines a property outside full counting CPT.

C243_WSC_SEMANTICS.statement: P2 01-formalism.tex requires witnesses on every first-stabilization path fixing parameters and the whole previous history, with polynomial temporary-object bounds.

C243_WSC_BOOLEAN.statement: P2 sen:all-input and sen:polynomial: the guarded one-WSC sentence is Boolean with one fixed resource polynomial on every finite input.

C243_WSC_WITNESS.statement: P2 grid:transitivity: every resolving parameter and compatible prefix has history-fixing full-input automorphism witnesses for every ordered candidate pair.

C243_WSC_GRID.statement: P2 grid:separation: all terminal paths accept zero charge and reject unit charge without dagger.

C243_WSC_TRACE.statement: P2 eval:trace: the complete deterministic evaluation trace is polynomial, invariant and membership-transitive, including rejected and stationarity candidates.

C243_WSC_DESCRIPTION.statement: P2 eval:description: actual activations have fixed-width exact evaluation descriptions, unique over the whole supported domain.

C243_WSC_LOWER.statement: P2 eval:pair-equivalence: every fixed CPT sentence agrees on the pair for sufficiently large L.

C243_NEW_RESULT.statement: A genuinely new publishable independent theorem or exact manuscript counterexample remains to be established, not replaced by a source inventory or finite exclusion.

C243_INDEPENDENT_REPLAY.statement: The independent Reviewer must replay and accept a publishable new result before campaign completion.
